text: sorry that mismatch is exactly the shit that makes 0 sense. so lets not be stupid about it. why would the focus show not the item i have in focus
resolution: Same ask as req_1983 (the focus mismatch) — the user's message was captured under both ids across turns. Resolved together: made the HELD item the top-priority focus so the properties panel always shows the item you have in focus, never falling through to an unrelated tile brush. shownFocus was ordered tiles > place-layer > held > tile-brush, so the held item was third and could be shadowed/leak TILE Asphalt; reordered so armedFocus wins outright, with focusWorld matched. With req_1959 (held props) + req_1962 (held build pieces get a piece focus), holding ANY catalog item now shows that item uniformly. Verified compiling green; left uncommitted in the working tree because index.tsx also holds another session's MINIMAL_REPRO probe (per the user's let-them-do-their-thing). See req_1983 for the canonical entry.
